Per-dialect field presence records explicit nulls (for example VS Code call ts 0.0136: calls are dated only by responseTimestamp, which current session documents omit; documented).

vd-000c research recipes at 9820bb5 (assets/evidence/recipes-9820bb5.json): all 24 shipped recipes rendered by unisphere prep recipe NAME --target DIR and run through external duckdb 1.5.5 -csv with 0 failures and no stderr on a synthetic target prepped from every harness's committed fixtures (3 recipes legitimately empty there: idle-wakes, idle-tax, tool-loops) and on the real all-harness target (0 empty).

vd-000b full-corpus measurement at 6161ba6 (assets/evidence/measure-6161ba6.json; load average 130.7 before, 54.2 after): cold 42.5 s, 13.97 GB read, peak RSS 3.97 GB, 559,707 calls / 1,533,456 tool_uses / 70,593 turns written, state.json 54.6 MB; unchanged re-run 49.5 s wall (0.66 s user CPU in a follow-up timing) with 17.2 MB read from 5 live-appended sources; append re-run after 60 s 37.5 s, 15.3 MB read. Findings escalated to the prime: warm wall time is discovery I/O wait (Copilot CLI session-state holds 10,385 directories; a plain os.walk takes 22 s at this load), and peak memory grows with the rows of one run because run_prep commits once. POC baseline: Claude 3.46 s cold / 507 MB, 0.05-0.62 s warm.

Prime rulings on the lg-000b findings (pij-suspicious-meadowlark): (A) commit waves with an adjustable --max-run-bytes; (1) incremental discovery keeping glob semantics (persisted per-directory mtime/entry index, re-list only changed directories, stat known sources directly), both in the same guide revision, re-verify and review. Convergence: Plan 029's crate-private fold_source read-loop extraction (b9c86e67, sdk/src/prep.rs only) applied cleanly as 42034b5 before these changes so 029 rebases onto 028's ownership.

8428dc4 incremental discovery and commit waves. Discovery: core walk_prep_root with a PrepWalkFs port (both loaders), PrepLoader::discover takes the previous index, PrepSetState.discovery holds each binding's index, racy directories (mtime within 2 s of listing) are never reused; a real-filesystem test proves a new file deep in an unchanged tree lists one directory, an unchanged tree lists none, a replaced subtree is found through its parent and results equal a full walk. Waves: PrepRequest.max_run_bytes (default 256 MiB) bounds rows per durable commit; tests prove budgets split waves, equal a single wave, and a failure after a committed wave keeps it. The SDK now moves the committed state and the Parquet store publishes it through a borrowed view instead of cloning it. Default chosen from the real corpus: 1 GiB gave 14 commits at 2.2 GB peak RSS, 256 MiB 57 commits at 1.9 GB, 64 MiB 225 commits at 2.3 GB (per-commit state rewrites dominate below that). Guide delta recorded in meta.updated (dfb8bf8).

POC baseline: Claude 3.46 s cold / 507 MB, 0.05-0.62 s warm; this is the all-harness corpus (14 GB, 5,423 sources) under shared-machine load.
